fixed.climate: dream-midsummer woodland: warm, still air under a full canopy (grown from LOC-riverside-region via LOC-thick-wood)

dream_design.flora: foxglove spires and arching bracken fronds line the path; honeysuckle twines along the Cat's low bough and hangs in pale trumpets; ivy spirals up the trunks. The Cat's bough and the higher branch are sinuous, whiplash-curved limbs, the two strongest lines in the frame
dream_design.ornament_cues: gaps in the canopy form round halo roundels of sky behind the boughs, so the Cat sits framed in a disc of light; the ivy and honeysuckle make a living floral border around the path
dream_design.palette: deep moss and bottle green set against pastel foxglove mauve, honeysuckle cream and pale gold coins of sunlight; soft gold on backlit leaf edges
dream_design.seasonal_guard: foxglove and honeysuckle flower in July; no spring bluebells, no autumn colour
dream_design.reason: Trees and boughs are explicit (ch006-p49, p70, p79). Climbers, the roundel framing and the palette are designed to WR-010. The leaves stay still in every state, so the dissolve stays clean (SUP-005).

fixed.ground_and_flora: a dry, beaten woodland path through English copse country; oak, ash and beech in full dark-green July leaf; bracken and foxgloves along the path; the Cat's low bough and, further on, a higher branch
fixed.dream_growth: Grows from Dinah watching from a garden bough near the family house (cp-cat). The dappled shade is the real afternoon sun broken by the trees over the sleeping Alice; the Cat's grin comes and goes the way a patch of sunlight comes and goes on a bough. That is the in-world source of the photographic dissolve (SUP-005).

source.quote: she was a little startled by seeing the Cheshire Cat sitting on a bough of a tree a few yards off

fixed.reason: Trees and boughs are explicit (ch006-p49, ch006-p70). Species, undergrowth, the dappled light and the dream link are designed for July in lowland England, per ruling 5.2 A.
